title: Finite state machine runner
description: Implement run_machine(transitions, start, events). transitions maps (state, event) tuples to the next state. Process events in order and return (final_state, trace) where trace is the list of states after each event.
invariants: An event with no transition from the current state is ignored: the state stays and the unchanged state is still appended to trace.
Raise ValueError if start does not appear as a state in any key or value of transitions.
